claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $291.9M versus $363.2M a year earlier, while battery shipments increased sequentially to 113.8 MWh and Europe revenue rose about 35% sequentially.

Enphase is extending its power-electronics platform toward AI data-center infrastructure through IQ SST; customer opportunities have advanced to RFI/RFP stages representing a potential multi-gigawatt pipeline, but commercial conversion is not yet proven.

risks.risk: Q2 GAAP gross margin was boosted by $45.4M of prior-period tariff refunds; non-GAAP gross margin of 46.8% is more representative of ongoing economics.
Q2 revenue remained materially below Q2 2025, and U.S. revenue declined about 3% sequentially.

unknowns.unknown: IQ SST multi-gigawatt opportunities are pipeline, not contracted revenue; timing, economics and win rates remain unknown.

claims.claim: Q2 revenue of $291.9M landed inside prior $280M-$310M guidance and Q3 guidance is $290M-$320M, indicating stabilization expectations rather than a demonstrated return to year-over-year growth.

risks.risk: Safe-harbor revenue, tax-credit mechanics and tariff refunds can obscure normalized demand and margin trends if not separated.

unknowns.unknown: A full-system IQ SST demonstration is planned later in 2026; commercial proof remains outstanding.
